title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V
scope: Covers requirements for polyvinyl chloride insulated heavy duty electric cables with copper or aluminium conductors for working voltages up to and including 1100 volts. Includes armoured and unarmoured constructions for power distribution, underground laying and industrial installations. Specifies conductor, insulation, inner sheath, armour and outer sheath requirements.

title: Cross-Linked Polyethylene Insulated Thermoplastic Sheathed Cables Part 1 For Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V
scope: Specifies requirements for cross-linked polyethylene XLPE insulated PVC sheathed cables with copper or aluminium conductors for working voltages up to and including 1100 volts. Covers armoured and unarmoured types suitable for underground distribution and industrial power circuits where higher current rating and thermal performance than PVC insulation is required.

title: Conductors for Insulated Electric Cables and Flexible Cords
scope: Specifies requirements for conductors used in insulated electric cables and flexible cords, covering plain and metal coated annealed copper and aluminium conductors. Defines classes of conductor, nominal cross-sectional areas, number and diameter of wires and maximum resistance values at twenty degrees Celsius.

title: Methods of Test for Cables Part 1 Measurement of Thickness of Insulation and Sheath
scope: Prescribes the method of test for measurement of thickness of insulation and sheath of electric cables using a measuring microscope or profile projector. Applies to all types of insulated cables covered by relevant Indian Standards.

title: Methods of Test for Cables Part 7 Tensile Strength and Elongation at Break
scope: Prescribes the method of test for determination of tensile strength and elongation at break of insulation and sheath materials of electric cables, including sample preparation, conditioning and testing machine requirements.

title: Recommended Current Ratings for Cables Part 2 PVC Insulated and PVC Sheathed Heavy Duty Cables
scope: Gives recommended current ratings for PVC insulated and PVC sheathed heavy duty cables under various conditions of installation including laying direct in ground, in ducts and in air, with derating factors for ambient temperature, grouping and depth of laying.

title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations
scope: Provides a code of practice for the design, selection, erection, inspection and testing of electrical wiring installations in buildings for voltages not exceeding 1100 volts AC. Covers protection against electric shock, thermal effects, overcurrent, selection and erection of wiring systems, isolation and switching, and earthing arrangements.

title: Code of Practice for Earthing
scope: Provides guidance on the design and installation of earthing systems for electrical installations, covering earth electrodes, earthing conductors, soil resistivity measurement, earth fault loop impedance, equipotential bonding and earthing for substations, generating stations and buildings.

title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables and Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductor
scope: Specifies requirements for polyvinyl chloride insulated unsheathed and sheathed cables and flexible cords with rigid and flexible copper conductors for voltages up to and including 1100 volts, intended for internal wiring of buildings, appliance connection and portable equipment.

title: PVC Insulation and Sheath of Electric Cables
scope: Specifies requirements for polyvinyl chloride compounds used as insulation and sheath of electric cables, including types of compound, physical properties before and after ageing, hot deformation, loss of mass and thermal stability requirements.

title: Mild Steel Wires Formed Wires and Tapes for Armouring of Cables
scope: Specifies requirements for mild steel wires, formed wires and tapes used for armouring of electric cables, covering dimensions, tolerances, tensile strength, elongation, torsion, coating mass and adhesion of zinc coating.

title: Glossary of Terms Relating to Electric Cables and Conductors
scope: Defines terms relating to electric cables and conductors including constructional terms, electrical terms, test terms and terms relating to installation and accessories.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for ordinary Portland cement of 33, 43 and 53 grades including chemical requirements, physical requirements of fineness, soundness, setting time and compressive strength, and requirements for packing, marking and sampling.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement 43 Grade Specification
scope: Specified requirements for 43 grade ordinary Portland cement. This standard has been merged into IS 269 which now covers 33, 43 and 53 grades in a single specification.

title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement Part 1 Determination of Fineness by Dry Sieving
scope: Prescribes the method for determination of fineness of hydraulic cement by dry sieving using a 90 micron IS sieve, including apparatus, procedure and calculation of residue percentage.

title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement Part 4 Determination of Consistency of Standard Cement Paste
scope: Prescribes the method for determination of the quantity of water required to produce a cement paste of standard consistency using the Vicat apparatus.

title: Method of Chemical Analysis of Hydraulic Cement
scope: Prescribes methods of chemical analysis of hydraulic cement covering determination of loss on ignition, insoluble residue, silica, iron oxide, alumina, calcium oxide, magnesia, sulphuric anhydride, alkalies and chlorides.

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete Code of Practice
scope: Provides a code of practice for general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete, covering materials, workmanship, inspection and testing, concrete mix proportioning, durability requirements, structural design by limit state method and working stress method, and detailing of reinforcement.

title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for coarse and fine aggregates from natural sources and manufactured aggregates for use in concrete, covering quality, grading, deleterious materials, soundness, alkali aggregate reactivity and sampling and testing requirements.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for high strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement in grades Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 550 and Fe 600 including chemical composition, mechanical properties, bond requirements, rib geometry, bend and rebend tests.

certification.product: Deformed steel bars for concrete reinforcement

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for hot rolled medium and high tensile structural steel plates, strips, sections, flats and bars for use in structural work including chemical composition, tensile properties, impact properties, bend test and surface quality.

title: Metallic Materials Tensile Testing at Ambient Temperature
scope: Specifies the method for tensile testing of metallic materials at ambient temperature and defines the mechanical properties which can be determined including yield strength, proof stress, tensile strength, percentage elongation after fracture and percentage reduction of area.

title: Metallic Materials Bend Test
scope: Specifies the method for determining the ability of metallic materials to undergo plastic deformation in bending, including test piece dimensions, mandrel diameter, bending angle and evaluation of the test.

title: Technical Supply Conditions for Threaded Steel Fasteners Part 3 Mechanical Properties of Fasteners Made of Carbon Steel and Alloy Steel Bolts Screws and Studs
scope: Specifies mechanical and physical properties of bolts, screws and studs made of carbon steel and alloy steel when tested at ambient temperature, including property classes, tensile strength, proof load, hardness and designation system.

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes Safety Requirements for Portable Sealed Secondary Lithium Cells and Batteries Part 1 Cells
scope: Specifies safety requirements and tests for portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries for use in portable applications, covering electrical, mechanical and environmental abuse tests including overcharge, short circuit, crush, impact, thermal abuse and forced discharge.

title: Self Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services Part 1 Safety Requirements
scope: Specifies safety and interchangeability requirements together with test methods for self ballasted LED lamps with integrated means of stable operation intended for domestic and similar general lighting purposes having rated wattage up to 60 W and rated voltage up to 250 V.

title: Self Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services Part 2 Performance Requirements
scope: Specifies performance requirements for self ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services including luminous flux, luminous efficacy, colour rendering index, correlated colour temperature, lumen maintenance and lamp survival factor.

title: Safety of Lamp Control Gear Part 1 General and Safety Requirements
scope: Specifies general and safety requirements for lamp control gear for use on DC supplies up to 1000 V and AC supplies up to 1000 V at 50 Hz or 60 Hz, covering protection against electric shock, insulation resistance, electric strength, thermal endurance and fault conditions.

title: Gold and Gold Alloys Jewellery Artefacts Fineness and Marking Specification
scope: Specifies fineness grades and marking requirements for gold and gold alloy jewellery and artefacts, including permitted caratages, hallmarking components comprising BIS mark, purity grade, assaying centre identification and jeweller identification mark.

title: Assaying of Gold in Gold Bullion Gold Alloys and Gold Jewellery Artefacts Cupellation Fire Assay Method
scope: Prescribes the cupellation or fire assay method for determination of gold content in gold bullion, gold alloys and gold jewellery and artefacts, including sampling, apparatus, reagents, procedure and expression of results.

title: Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Artefacts
scope: Covers the procedure for hallmarking of gold jewellery and artefacts including the components of the hallmark, method of application, responsibilities of assaying and hallmarking centres and requirements for record keeping.

title: Steel Pipes for Water and Sewage Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for electric resistance welded and submerged arc welded steel pipes of nominal bore 150 mm to 2540 mm for use in water and sewage conveyance, covering material, dimensions, tolerances, hydrostatic test and protective coating.

title: Unplasticized PVC Pipes for Potable Water Supplies Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for unplasticized polyvinyl chloride UPVC pipes for potable water supplies covering material, classification by pressure rating, dimensions, tolerances, visual appearance, reversion test, hydrostatic characteristics and effect on water quality.

title: Thermoplastics Pipes and Fittings Methods of Test Part 1 Measurement of Dimensions
scope: Prescribes methods for measurement of dimensions of thermoplastics pipes and fittings including outside diameter, wall thickness, out of roundness and length.

title: Polyvinyl Chloride PVC and its Copolymers for Safe Use in Contact with Foodstuffs Pharmaceuticals and Drinking Water Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for polyvinyl chloride and its copolymers intended for safe use in contact with foodstuffs, pharmaceuticals and drinking water including permitted additives, migration limits and toxicity requirements.

title: Low Voltage Switchgear and Controlgear Part 1 General Rules
scope: Lays down general rules for low voltage switchgear and controlgear including definitions, classification, characteristics, product information, normal service conditions, constructional and performance requirements and verification tests for equipment intended for circuits with rated voltage not exceeding 1000 V AC.

title: Low Voltage Switchgear and Controlgear Part 2 Circuit Breakers
scope: Specifies requirements for circuit breakers for low voltage applications including rated currents, breaking capacity, making capacity, temperature rise limits, dielectric properties, short circuit performance and coordination requirements.

title: Low Voltage Switchgear and Controlgear Assemblies Part 1 Type Tested and Partially Type Tested Assemblies
scope: Specifies requirements for low voltage switchgear and controlgear assemblies including panel boards and distribution boards for rated voltages not exceeding 1000 V AC, covering degrees of protection, clearances and creepage distances, temperature rise, short circuit withstand strength and electromagnetic compatibility.

title: Classification of Degrees of Protection Provided by Enclosures of Electrical Equipment
scope: Specifies the system of classification of degrees of protection provided by enclosures for electrical equipment against ingress of solid foreign objects and water, defining the IP code, designations and corresponding verification tests.

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances Part 1 General Requirements
scope: Deals with the safety of electrical appliances for household and similar purposes with rated voltage not more than 250 V for single phase appliances, covering protection against access to live parts, starting, input and current, heating, leakage current, electric strength, abnormal operation, stability and mechanical hazards.

title: Methods of Tests for Strength of Concrete
scope: Prescribes methods of tests for determining compressive strength, flexural strength and modulus of elasticity of concrete, covering making and curing of test specimens, apparatus, procedure and calculation of results.

title: Concrete Mix Proportioning Guidelines
scope: Provides guidelines for proportioning concrete mixes to achieve target strength and workability including selection of water cement ratio, estimation of water content, calculation of cement content, proportion of aggregates and trial mix procedure.

title: Methods of Test for Aggregates for Concrete Part 1 Particle Size and Shape
scope: Prescribes methods of test for determination of particle size distribution, flakiness index and elongation index of aggregates used in concrete.

title: Test Sieves Part 1 Wire Cloth Test Sieves
scope: Specifies requirements for wire cloth test sieves including nominal aperture sizes, wire diameters, tolerances, frame dimensions and marking requirements.

title: Safety of Toys Part 1 Mechanical and Physical Properties
scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for mechanical and physical properties of toys including sharp edges, sharp points, small parts, projections, cords and elastics, folding mechanisms and requirements for toys intended for children under 36 months.

title: Safety of Toys Part 3 Migration of Certain Elements
scope: Specifies maximum acceptable levels and methods of test for the migration of antimony, arsenic, barium, cadmium, chromium, lead, mercury and selenium from toy materials and parts of toys.

title: Solar Photovoltaic Systems Part 1 Standalone Photovoltaic Lighting Systems
scope: Specifies requirements for standalone photovoltaic lighting systems including PV module, battery, charge controller, lamp and luminaire, covering performance requirements, protection features and test methods for solar street lighting and home lighting systems.

title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic PV Modules Design Qualification and Type Approval
scope: Specifies requirements for design qualification and type approval of crystalline silicon terrestrial photovoltaic modules suitable for long term operation in general open air climates, covering visual inspection, performance at STC, insulation test, thermal cycling, humidity freeze, damp heat, mechanical load and hail impact tests.

title: Guide for Safety Procedures and Practices in Electrical Work Part 1 General
scope: Provides guidance on safety procedures and practices to be observed during electrical work including precautions against electric shock, permit to work systems, earthing before work, use of protective equipment and first aid for electric shock.

title: Code of Practice for Design Installation and Maintenance of Service Lines up to and including 650 Volts
scope: Provides a code of practice for design, installation and maintenance of overhead and underground service lines up to and including 650 volts, covering conductor selection, clearances, supports, terminations and protection arrangements.

title: Standard Sand for Testing Cement Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for standard sand used for testing of cement including source, chemical composition, particle size distribution and packing requirements.

title: Methods of Sampling Hydraulic Cement
scope: Prescribes methods of sampling hydraulic cement from bags, bulk storage and conveyors including sampling apparatus, size of sample, number of samples, preparation of composite sample and packing and marking of samples.

title: Specification for Moulds for Use in Tests of Cement and Concrete
scope: Specifies requirements for metal moulds used in making test specimens of cement and concrete including cube moulds, cylinder moulds and beam moulds, covering dimensions, tolerances, material and construction.

title: Methods of Test for Aggregates for Concrete Part 3 Specific Gravity Density Voids Absorption and Bulking
scope: Prescribes methods of test for determination of specific gravity, density, voids, water absorption and bulking of fine and coarse aggregates used in concrete.

title: Metallic Materials Rockwell Hardness Test Part 1 Test Method
scope: Specifies the method for Rockwell hardness test for metallic materials including scales, indenters, test force, procedure, and conversion of hardness values.

title: Metallic Materials Charpy Pendulum Impact Test Method
scope: Specifies the Charpy pendulum impact test method for determining the energy absorbed by metallic materials in fracture, covering test pieces, apparatus, test temperature and expression of results.

title: Secondary Lithium Cells and Batteries for Portable Applications Terminology
scope: Defines terms relating to secondary lithium cells and batteries for portable applications including cell types, capacity terms, charging terms, safety terms and performance terms.
